messages:
jia: Heads-up — spun up pelican-embed-v2 on staging for a cohesion + recall probe. Quick smoke: semantic-sim, clustering, recall@k.

sam: Nice. Dataset? seeds?

jia: semantic-holdout-v3, 10k queries stratified by frequency & lang. seeds=0..2. float32 baseline and int8 naive first.

noah: Any immediate red flags?

jia: Short summary: recall@1/10/100 fp32=0.44/0.74/0.89, int8=0.41/0.70/0.86. Biggest drops on very short queries (<4 tokens) and mixed-language tail.

marta: Oof. Cluster metrics?

jia: silhouette mean fp32=0.24, int8=0.18. Davies-Bouldin fp32=1.62, int8=1.93. So cohesion + separation worsened.

sam: Can you paste exact command you used?

jia: Ran from staging-evals container:
```
PYTHONPATH=. pytest tests/evals/bringup_cohesion.py::test_run \
  --dataset semantic-holdout-v3 --model pelican-embed-v2 \
  --quant int8 --seeds 0,1,2 --out /tmp/pelican-cohesion.json
```

noah: Did you check preprocessing parity (norms, tokenization)?

jia: Yep. Tokenization and L2 norming identical. Hypothesis: last linear per-channel variance when using symmetric quant.

evals-bot: automated-check: recall-delta@10 = -0.04; silhouette-delta = -0.06; flag=investigate

sam: Ok let's try per-channel int8 and qAT calibration with 1k samples. Also collect lang & length breakdown.

jia: Kicked off two jobs: job_9931 (per-channel) and job_9932 (qAT-1k). Added breakdown args.

ops-bot: job_9931 started on runner-eval-2 (A10G), job_9932 queued. ETA ~8m.

noah: If per-channel recovers, we should update Optimize's recommended profile. Also consider hybrid 6-bit for short queries.

marta: And add note to model card about multilingual short-query sensitivity.

ops-bot: job_9931 finished. Artifacts: /artifacts/job_9931/pelican-perchannel.csv, umap-perchannel.png

jia: Per-channel results: recall@10 delta -0.009; silhouette delta -0.015. Lang/length snippet:
```
length_bucket,recall10_fp32,recall10_int8_perchannel,delta
<4,0.61,0.58,-0.03
4-8,0.74,0.73,-0.01
>8,0.78,0.77,-0.01
```

sam: Much better than naive int8. What about qAT?

ops-bot: job_9932 finished. Artifacts: /artifacts/job_9932/qAT-1k.json

jia: qAT-1k: recall@10 delta -0.005; silhouette delta -0.009. Slightly worse than per-channel on short queries but close overall.

noah: Actionable plan: (1) recommend per-channel quant profile for pelican-embed-v2; (2) fallback to qAT if hw/platform doesn't support per-channel; (3) consider hybrid int6 for short-query shards as optional config. Update model card and Optimize recommendations.

sam: I'll open the PR with PR template: quant profile, links to artifacts (umaps, CSVs), and rollout checklist.

marta: Also request: run a small synthetic paraphrase bench (paraphrase-synth-5k) to ensure pairwise semantic pairs still align. Jia please run and attach results.

jia: On it — starting paraphrase-synth job job_9933.

ops-bot: job_9933 finished. Artifacts: /artifacts/job_9933/paraphrase-synth-results.csv

jia: Paraphrase bench shows F1 drop ~1.2% for naive int8, per-channel reduces to ~0.3% drop.

noah: Great. Sounds like per-channel is the sweet spot. Once PR merges we can schedule a canary rollout with traffic-split and monitor recall metric in Console.

marta: Agreed. Thanks everyone. Ping when PR is up. :thumbsup:
